presentation.fullstack: And I work as a Full Stack Developer
presentation.paragraph1: After a rich, varied and diversified career path, I decided to specialize in the field of computer science and more particularly in web development and application design. Passionate about the world of entrepreneurship and new technologies, I continuously learn and evolve according to the required skills and market demand.
presentation.paragraph2: I design, develop and optimize web applications, from idea to realization through to production deployment. I dedicate time to self-training and constantly adapt to innovations and emerging new technologies. One of my objectives is therefore to aim to exploit those that prove relevant to successfully carry out the missions entrusted to me.
presentation.paragraph3: Therefore, I wish to contribute to ambitious and transformative projects, alongside committed companies that share strong values.

mesProjets.title: My Projects & Achievements
mesProjets.intro:
Discover my completed, recent and upcoming projects. Some have been deployed by me and others professionally in collaboration with other developers.
For confidentiality reasons, I cannot provide the source code of projects made in companies.
However, I have created some demo videos to showcase the features and ergonomics of these projects.

contact.title: Contact Me
contact.paragraph:
Are you looking for a developer, a web integrator or even a tester to strengthen your team?

I am currently seeking a professional opportunity and would be delighted to discuss a future collaboration.

Feel free to contact me to talk about a project, learn more about my profile or simply ask questions.

I remain available and responsive, and I will be happy to reply.
